persona: Agency SEO executive with four years of client SEO
resumeText:
Mohammed Faizan | Hyderabad | faizan.m@example.com

EXPERIENCE
SEO Executive, Charminar Digital Agency, Hyderabad (2022 - present)
- Handle on-page SEO for 8 client websites in real estate, edtech and healthcare.
- Built keyword maps for 600 pages grouped by search intent and funnel stage.
- Earned 120 backlinks a quarter through guest posting and digital PR outreach.
- Monitor coverage, indexing and performance reports in Google Search Console every week.
- Use Ahrefs and Semrush for competitor gap and keyword difficulty research.
- Set up GA4 conversion events and organic landing page reports for clients.
- Send monthly reports on keyword rankings and organic traffic to each client.

Content Writer, Lakdi Ka Pul Media, Hyderabad (2021 - 2022)
- Wrote 15 local news articles a week for the website.

SKILLS
SEO audits, Schema markup, WordPress, Excel

EDUCATION
BCom, Osmania University, 2021
